title: GCP GPU VM variables
description: Configuration variables for GCP GPU VMs

GPU_VM_VERSION.description: Specific version of gpu-vm to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

GPU_VM_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for gcp-gpu-vm: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

GPU_VM_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for GPU_VM to listen on

GPU_VM_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for GPU_VM to listen on

GPU_VM_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for GPU_VM to listen on

GCP_GPU_VM_ENABLED.description: Flag (0 or 1) indicating whether gcp-gpu-vm is enabled in the execution plan.
